name: The R Apartments Mezzanine with Plunge Pool

facts.text: A 48 m² mezzanine studio for up to 3 guests, with king beds and sofa beds.
A private plunge pool with direct access from the unit, a garden and poolside seating; a private entrance.
Air conditioning, WiFi, TV and hot water; a dedicated office space, a safe box and a hair dryer; linens and towels are provided.
Full kitchen with stove, microwave, blender, coffee maker, toaster, kettle and a refrigerator with freezer.
Free parking on the premises. Pererenan Beach is about 5 minutes on foot.
